title: omni-sync users roster
description: Gitignored team roster (PII). Users are keyed on email and groups reference those email keys. Never committed.

users.description: Map of email address -> per-host usernames.

propertyNames.description: Email address is the pivot key for a person.

additionalProperties.description: A person's usernames per host. Omit a host the person lacks.

gh.description: github.com login, or an empty placeholder when unknown.

helix.description: github.helix.gsa.gov LOGIN (not the _gsagov SSO handle), or an empty placeholder when unknown.

gitlab.description: workshop.cloud.gov (GitLab) username, or an empty placeholder when unknown.

groups.description: Map of stable team slug -> membership and optional GitHub team metadata.

members.description: Email keys from [users]. Cross-reference validation is performed by the loader.

github_org.description: Optional GitHub organization used for future team provisioning.

github_team.description: Optional GitHub team slug used for provisioning or CODEOWNERS generation.
